m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (global-crew.md, global-everyone.md), the project deltas (docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md if present), and the handoff at .agent-work/w3-ci/crew-handoffs/g1-implement-handoff.md. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff read in full and confirmed complete
postconditions.satisfied_by: Read global-crew.md, global-everyone.md, checklist-engine.md, CREW_CONTEXT.md, and the g1-implement-handoff.md handoff in full. Handoff is complete: task, protected intent, test mode, close criteria, allowed scope, exclusions, constraints w/ @grade tags, map anchors, required evidence, verification commands, authority, stop conditions, return format all present.

m1-add-job.title: Add ubuntu-latest job mirroring windows-latest job
m1-add-job.imperative: Add exactly one new job `ubuntu-latest` to .github/workflows/ci.yml, alongside the existing `test` job, mirroring its steps (checkout, setup-python 3.12, install pytest+coverage, MCP-door smoke test, full pytest run, skip guard, coverage floor) without the defaults.run.shell:bash override. Do not touch on:, env:, matrix, or the windows-latest job. Attest c1 by inspection diff.

postconditions.statement: git diff -- .github/workflows/ci.yml shows exactly one new ubuntu-latest job that mirrors the windows-latest job's steps; windows-latest job and on:/env: unchanged
postconditions.satisfied_by: git diff -- .github/workflows/ci.yml shows exactly one new job (test-linux, runs-on ubuntu-latest) added; windows-latest job, on:, and env: unchanged; YAML validated parseable with yaml.safe_load; jobs are ['test','test-linux']

m2-red-proof.title: Local red-proof: mutate, fail with named assertion, revert, re-green
m2-red-proof.imperative: Make an uncommitted, deliberately-broken mutation to one test in tests/ not reused from an existing documented fault-injection example. Run the exact command the new job's step runs and capture the SPECIFIC failing assertion text (not a bare non-zero exit or crash). Revert the mutation and confirm `git diff --quiet -- tests/; echo $?` prints 0. Re-run the same command and confirm it is green. Attest c1 by inspection of the transcript.

postconditions.statement: red transcript with named failing assertion captured; revert verified via git diff --quiet -- tests/ == 0; green re-run captured
postconditions.satisfied_by: Mutation: tests/test_agent_work_root.py::DurableRootEpicLeaseTests::test_no_lease_resolves_to_main changed assertEqual(_norm(resolved), _norm(self.main)) to _norm(self.linked). Ran python3 -m pytest tests/ -q --junitxml=junit-report.xml -k test_no_lease_resolves_to_main -> FAILED with AssertionError: '/tmp/tmpv1n1h5ll/main' != '/tmp/tmpv1n1h5ll/linked' (specific named assertion, not bare exit/crash). Reverted via git checkout -- tests/test_agent_work_root.py; git diff --quiet -- tests/; echo $? printed 0. Re-ran same command -> 1 passed, 3737 deselected.

constraints: never use git status --porcelain to verify revert (autocrlf false-negative)

m3-verify.title: Final verification and result write
m3-verify.imperative: Run the handoff's Verification Commands (git diff -- .github/workflows/ci.yml; git diff --quiet -- tests/ && echo clean; git diff --stat) and confirm exactly one file changed overall. Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT to .agent-work/w3-ci/crew-handoffs/g1-implement-result.md. Attest c1.

preconditions.satisfied_by: red-proof performed and reverted, m2-red-proof complete

postconditions.statement: git diff --stat shows exactly one file changed (.github/workflows/ci.yml); IMPLEMENTER_RESULT written to the delivery path
postconditions.satisfied_by: git diff --stat shows exactly one file changed (.github/workflows/ci.yml, 30 insertions); IMPLEMENTER_RESULT written to .agent-work/w3-ci/crew-handoffs/g1-implement-result.md

why_trail.why: Added test-linux job mirroring test job's steps minus the defaults.run.shell:bash override (unneeded on ubuntu default bash); diff inspection confirms scope boundary held.

Red-proof used a fresh mutation (assertEqual target swap) not previously demonstrated in this repo's fault-injection examples (ci.yml comment cites issue #229's proofs, different mechanism); revert verified via git diff --quiet per the autocrlf caveat, not git status --porcelain.
